assessments.reasoning: Section 6.1.6.2 describes BigInt values as integers with no fixed bit-width and explains binary operation behavior for negative values. Section 6.1.6 distinguishes Number and BigInt. An explicit width-conversion operation constrains its result independently of the underlying type.

challenge.method: Compare the BigInt type definition with the separate Number type. Test an integer exceeding machine word width, an explicit width conversion and mixed Number arithmetic as challenges to overbroad readings.
challenge.results: The abstract semantics impose no single representation width. Results from an explicitly width-constrained operation and from mixed addition do not redefine the type. The local Node.js v24.4.1 diagnostic agreed. 131-bit value maintained; explicit width conversion truncates; mixed addition throws.

limitations: A finite runtime experiment cannot establish the unbounded abstract specification or any implementation’s resource limit.
